<description>
The connman fuzz target never exercised `m_nodes` peers with queued messages, as their message queue is always empty. The most they ever had to send was handshake bytes in the case of v2 peers, so the socket handler only ever waited for SendEvent, and sent data, during a v2 handshake.

Fix this by pushing messages to one of the `m_nodes` peers instead of `random_node`, which is never added to connman.
</description>
